label: GO step after a rare-rewarded a1 trial (a1->S2 rewarded), late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), and only when the previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 that was rewarded (the previous-trial conditions cover ~90% of activations; the remaining ~10% are GO at rel -3, where the previous trial lies outside the window and is unknown, so they are likely the same case). It is also strongly restricted to late episode: no activations before ep_trial ~70, almost all at trials 80-99. Base condition alone: P=0.10 R=0.91; adding ep_trial>=78 gives dev P=0.44 R=0.90 F1=0.59. All predicate variables are observed. It does not fire after a2 rare-rewarded trials, after common or unrewarded trials. Firing is associated with low value (all in the bottom ~third of value) and a near-indifferent policy (choice logit diff mostly in -1.5..2.8); adding choice > -5 raises F1 only to 0.68, so I kept the simpler predicate. Coverage is flat across activation quartiles, so the predicate does not explain magnitude; I did not identify a magnitude modulator. Precision remains incomplete: many late-episode GO steps after a1-rare-rewarded trials do not activate.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a1 S2 r, ?) and trial before (GO: a1 S1 r, ?, a1 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=GO & ep_dec=7.
